ui.metaActionNotSent: Meta has not received this template. You can only use it to reply within 24 hours of the customer's last message.
ui.metaActionPending: Meta is reviewing it. It usually takes a few minutes, up to 24 hours. Do not send it yet.
ui.metaActionApproved: You can send it whenever you want, also outside the 24-hour window.
ui.metaActionRejected: Meta turned it down. Change the wording in WhatsApp Manager and send it back for review from there.
ui.metaActionPaused: Too many people reported it, so Meta will not deliver it for a while. Change the wording in WhatsApp Manager and send it back from there.
ui.metaActionDisabled: Meta will not accept this template again. Write a new one with different wording.
ui.metaActionDeleted: Meta no longer has this template, so nothing that uses it will be sent. Delete it here, or write a new one with a different name.
ui.metaActionUnknown: Check this template in WhatsApp Manager: Meta reports a status this screen does not know yet.
ui.emptyThread: No messages in this conversation yet.
ui.helpConnectNeedsNewerHub: This hub is too old to connect the number from here. Update the hub and come back to this screen.
ui.useAppointmentsSummary: A customer asks for an appointment on WhatsApp, the assistant offers the hours you actually have free, and books the one they pick — then tells them it is done, and tells them when you confirm their appointment.
ui.stepUses: What do you use it for?
ui.helpConnectScanQr: Scan the QR code with the WhatsApp Business app of your business number. You keep using WhatsApp on your phone as always.
ui.useAppointmentsPolicyReviewHelp: Each new booking waits for you in the Diary with “Confirm”; the customer is told you will confirm shortly.
ui.useAppointmentsPolicyError: We could not save how appointments are confirmed. Try again.
ui.usesNeedsNewerHub: This hub is too old to turn this on from here. Update the hub.
ui.usesNeedBookingModule: Install Appointments or Reservations so WhatsApp can book on its own
ui.usesNeedNewerBookingModule: Update Appointments or Reservations so WhatsApp can book on its own
ui.usesNeedMissingModule: “{use}” needs the {module} app, and it is not installed. Install it from Apps.
ui.usesNeedPausedModule: “{use}” needs the {module} app, and it is paused. Turn it back on in Apps.
ui.usesNeedUpdatedModule: “{use}” needs the {module} app at version {floor} or later, and this hub has {installed}. Update it in Apps.
ui.activateForbidden: Only an owner or an administrator can turn this on.
ui.errActivate: It could not be turned on. Nothing was changed — try again.
ui.errTemplates: We could not find out what is already turned on. Reload the screen.
ui.useAppointmentsConsent: WhatsApp will answer on its own: it reads your diary, offers free slots, books, moves or cancels the appointment of the customer who writes, and replies to them; and it tells them when you confirm their appointment. It cannot touch anyone else’s appointments. Turn it on?
ui.useAppointmentsDone: Done. Text your number from another phone: “I’d like an appointment tomorrow”.
ui.useReservationsSummary: A guest asks for a table on WhatsApp, the assistant checks the times you really have free, and books the one they pick — then tells them it is done.
ui.useReservationsConsent: WhatsApp will answer on its own: it checks free tables, books a table for whoever writes, and replies to them. Turn it on?
ui.useReservationsDone: Done. Text your number from another phone: “I’d like a table for two tomorrow”.
ui.useReservationsPolicyReviewHelp: Each new booking waits for you in Reservations with “Confirm”; the guest is told you will confirm shortly.
ui.useReservationsPolicyError: We could not save how table bookings are confirmed. Try again.
ui.doorRefusalUnknown: The template could not be registered with Meta, and the reason is one this screen does not know yet ({code}). It is saved here: look that code up in WhatsApp Manager or send it to support.
ui.doorRefusalNoCode: The template could not be registered with Meta. It is saved here: try saving it again in a moment.
ui.metaSyncUnavailable: We could not check with Meta for new verdicts, so what you see is the last we know. Open this tab again in a while.
ui.headerMediaImage: Image header: the image is chosen when the message is sent.
ui.headerMediaVideo: Video header: the video is chosen when the message is sent.
ui.headerMediaDocument: Document header: the document is chosen when the message is sent.
ui.templateManagedInMeta: This template has buttons or an image, video or document header, so its wording is changed in WhatsApp Manager. Open this tab again to see what Meta says.
ui.templateNamedVariablesInMeta: This template uses named variables ({{name}}), which ERPlora cannot register at Meta yet, so its wording is changed in WhatsApp Manager. Open this tab again to see what Meta says.
ui.metaOnlyTemplates: These WhatsApp Manager templates cannot be brought into this list yet (they use a carousel, a limited-time offer, a copy-code or WhatsApp Flow button, a location header, or a variable in the header). Manage them in WhatsApp Manager: {names}

doorRefusal.invalid_name: Meta did not accept the name. Use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only — no spaces or accents — and try again.
doorRefusal.invalid_category: Meta did not accept the category. Pick Utility, Marketing or Authentication and send it again.
doorRefusal.invalid_language: Meta did not accept the language. Write it as a Meta language code, such as es or en_US.
doorRefusal.invalid_placeholders: Meta did not accept the placeholders in the body. Number them in order, starting at {{1}} and with no gaps.
doorRefusal.invalid_header_placeholders: Meta did not accept the header: it takes at most one placeholder, and it has to be {{1}}.
doorRefusal.invalid_variables: Meta did not accept the list of variables. Give one name per placeholder used in the text.
doorRefusal.missing_body: Meta will not review an empty template. Write the message the customer is going to read.
doorRefusal.missing_example: Meta needs an example for every placeholder. Fill in what each one is worth in a real message.
doorRefusal.no_whatsapp_number: This business has no WhatsApp number connected yet. Connect it in Settings and send the template again.
doorRefusal.template_not_found: Meta no longer has this template. Save it again to send it back for review.
doorRefusal.meta_rate_limited: Meta is turning away requests for the moment. Nothing is wrong with the template: wait a few minutes and save it again.
doorRefusal.meta_permission_denied: Meta will not let this business manage templates. Check in WhatsApp Manager that the account is still connected and has permission.
doorRefusal.meta_unreachable: Meta did not answer. The template is saved here; save it again in a moment to send it for review.
doorRefusal.meta_template_failed: Meta turned the template down without saying why. Review it in WhatsApp Manager, where the reason is spelled out.
doorRefusal.cloud_rejected: erplora.com refused to register the template. It is saved here: try again, and contact support if it keeps happening.
doorRefusal.cloud_unreachable: This till could not reach erplora.com. The template is saved here; check the internet connection and save it again to send it for review.
doorRefusal.cloud_unreadable: erplora.com answered something this till could not read. The template is saved here — try again in a moment.
doorRefusal.hub_not_enrolled: This till is not yet paired with erplora.com, so it cannot send templates to Meta. Contact support.
doorRefusal.capability_denied: WhatsApp Inbox is not allowed to send WhatsApp messages on this hub. Grant it in Settings → Permissions and save the template again.

ui.mediaUnavailable: This attachment cannot be shown here yet: you can see it on your phone's WhatsApp.
ui.threadRepliesElsewhere: Replies are not sent from this screen: answer from WhatsApp on your phone, or let an automation reply.

errors.whatsapp_inbox.conversation_not_found: That conversation does not exist in this business.
errors.whatsapp_inbox.conversation_unreadable: That conversation could not be read, so nothing was created. Try again.
errors.whatsapp_inbox.request_not_deletable: That request cannot be deleted: it does not exist in this business, or it was fulfilled and has to stay for audit.
errors.whatsapp_inbox.request_not_found: That request does not exist in this business.
errors.whatsapp_inbox.request_not_fulfillable: Only a confirmed request can be marked as handled.
errors.whatsapp_inbox.request_not_pending: That request is not waiting for review: it does not exist in this business, or it was already approved, rejected or handled.
errors.whatsapp_inbox.request_unreadable: That request could not be read, so nothing was changed. Try again.
errors.whatsapp_inbox.template_already_here: This business already holds a template with that name and language (live or deleted here), so nothing was brought in.
errors.whatsapp_inbox.template_not_found: That template does not exist in this business.
